content.text:
Section 24 is compliant at our **preferred** position — no redline proposed.

- **24.1** gives us assignment without Vendor consent to an Affiliate (defined at § 1.1) and to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all/substantially all assets.
- **24.2** bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.4** confirms our change of control gives Vendor no termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right — well clear of walk-away territory.
- **24.3** keeps residual assignments mutual and consent-based with a reasonableness standard; § 13 lets us carry licence rights to a permitted assignee.

Noted but not flagged: the reasonableness standard in 24.2 is framed around assignee capability/financial standing, and the competitor bar is subject to our own consent — both remain within our control.
